design: Targeted rapid evidence review, not a systematic review, preregistered protocol or exhaustive negative search.
protocolTiming: Initial orientation searches preceded this consolidated log. Queries and selection were adapted as directness and contradictory findings emerged; no prospective registration is claimed.
reviewerRole: Maintaining agent; single-reviewer extraction and critical appraisal, not independent duplicate screening
inclusion: Human primary studies or original issuing-body/methodological guidance relevant to exact readiness propositions. English-accessible content published by cutoff; older foundational sources retained.
exclusion: Reviews used only for discovery unless an original authoritative position/consensus statement; commercial scores, unrelated activity populations/endpoints, duplicate preprints and unverified snippets are not direct validation.
retrievalSystem: Web system1 discovery; direct primary publisher, PubMed, PMC and issuing-body pages/PDFs where available. No comprehensive database export.

selectionNote: Selected for relevance, directness and contrasting findings, not a target number of positive papers. Search ranking and tool result caps limit reproducibility of the result set; queries and retained URLs remain reproducible. No invented PRISMA counts.
directSearchFinding: No direct validation of the exact Metron 3-by-3 rule, its 5/7-hour decision boundaries, set ratios or 1.5-times step trigger was identified in this bounded search. This is not proof that no such evidence exists.
